rubric.correctness: Can the student describe the Ashtasthana Pariksha (8-point examination: Nadi, Mutra, Mala, Jihva, Shabda, Sparsha, Drik, Akruti) and Dashavidha Pariksha?
rubric.depth: Does the student understand how Nadi (pulse) diagnosis reflects the current state of all three doshas and their sub-types?
rubric.tradeoffAwareness: When is Ashtasthana Pariksha insufficient and must be supplemented with modern diagnostic tests?
rubric.realWorldApplicability: Can the student conduct a complete Rogipariksha for a patient presenting with chronic fatigue and correctly document the Prakriti-Vikriti differential?

rubric.correctness: Can the student differentiate Vata-type, Pitta-type, and Kapha-type presentations of similar symptoms (e.g., three types of Jwara/fever)?
rubric.depth: Does the student understand Samprapti (pathogenesis) — the 6 stages of disease development (Sanchaya → Pradosha → Prakopavastha)?
rubric.tradeoffAwareness: When does a symptom cluster require referral to modern medicine vs Ayurvedic management? What are the red flags?
rubric.realWorldApplicability: Can the student correctly differentiate Amavata (similar to RA) from Sandhi-gata Vata (osteoarthritis) and propose distinct treatment plans?

rubric.correctness: Can the student apply the Chikitsa Chatushpada (4 components: Physician, Drug, Attendant, Patient) and design a Shodhan vs Shaman treatment protocol?
rubric.depth: Does the student understand Panchakarma indications/contraindications, seasonal regimens (Ritucharya), and Pathya-Apathya (dietary codes)?
rubric.tradeoffAwareness: When is Shodhana (elimination therapy) preferred over Shamana (palliation)? How does patient Bala (strength) affect the choice?
rubric.realWorldApplicability: Can the student design a complete 21-day Panchakarma treatment plan for a corporate executive with chronic stress-induced Pitta disorders?

rubric.correctness: Can the student assess Deha Prakriti (physical constitution) and Manasa Prakriti (psychological constitution) using validated questionnaires and clinical observation?
rubric.depth: Does the student understand the genetic and epigenetic basis of Prakriti and its implications for personalised medicine and disease susceptibility?
rubric.tradeoffAwareness: How does Vikriti (current imbalance) differ from Prakriti (baseline constitution), and how does this distinction guide treatment sequencing?
rubric.realWorldApplicability: Can the student use Prakriti assessment to predict a patient's drug metabolism pattern and customise an Ayurvedic formulation accordingly?
